description: A long flat down the west side of the fourth floor, glass along the length of it and the mountains at the far end. Oak, pale plaster, a platform bed, a galley kitchen in grey stone, heating underfoot. Leave east to the landing.

window.description: A tall pane runs floor to ceiling down one wall, black-framed, holding the city out there like something in a case.
window.name: the window

name: Solenne Residence 4-A
